g.text: ThingsBoard 3.6 WebSocket 订阅完整时序
Upgrade 与 handler 内鉴权
The security filter skips and permits this path.

put internal session in pending Caffeine cache

enqueue inbound text and parse serially

[aggregate subscription changed and manager owner is local]

filter target services and subscribed keys

Actor and Rule Engine may produce data changes.
They are not part of the WebSocket command path.

blacklist external sessionId and drop later updates
cancel all v1 subscriptions by session

or previously-added limit set entries behind.

There is no durable WebSocket offset or session migration.
